entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return these ridiculously expensive cycling shoes. This is unbelievable.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yeah, it's VF88675309. I bought them almost two months ago and they're useless. I want a refund and I don't want to hear any excuses.

I see the order right here. I understand you're frustrated, but to make sure I'm helping correctly, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

What kind of a question is that?! They're giving me horrible blisters on every ride! The fit is a disaster and the placement for the cleats feels completely off. I've tried everything. I'm done with them. I want my money back. Get me your manager right now, I am not playing games.

I assure you, there's no need for a manager. I can handle this request for you directly. I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing you blisters. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thanks for holding. I've reviewed your order date, and you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Wait, what? Seriously? You're just... approving it?

Yes, of course. Our policy is quite clear. As long as it's within 10 days, we can take it back. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on file. You can pack the cycling shoes up, attach the label, and your refund will be issued once we receive them.
Oh. Wow. Okay. I was expecting a huge fight. So, I just print the label and send them back?
That's all you need to do. Once they arrive at our warehouse, you'll see the funds back in your account within 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's it. Uh, thank you, David. Sorry for getting so heated earlier.
No problem at all, I completely understand. Happy I could get this sorted out for you. Have a great day.
